completeOriginalSourceQuestionUnchanged.individualQuestion: Preserve all FIVE placements: Abjuration rank8/21RP and Evocation,Illusion,Transmutation,Universal rank9/26RP; each promises SEVEN LAYERS with differing or devastating effects and Core Action/120ft/concentration up to1minute. Current class-access records select rank8 Abjuration; reconcile access/rank/cost explicitly rather than treating five placements as five learned spells. Author seven distinct complete native layer effects,geometry,order,entry/crossing resolution,save/damage/condition outcomes,layer removal and sight/attack/movement barriers. Do not import an external rainbow damage/disintegration/banishment table; any planar branch remains post-push. Resolve repeated crossing,forced movement,suppression and layer state without restoring destroyed layers by a boundary toggle or multiplying one event indefinitely.

sourceEnvelope.completeHistoricalCommonQuestionUnchange: For every selected spell, settle all operational fields: actual activation and components, legal target/range/geometry, duration and concentration, resolution/DC/save or attack, full effect clauses, scaling, repeat casting/source identity, suppression/ending, limits and class-specific rank/cost access. commonRules.casting: Use the exact casting interface in ACCEPTED_INTERFACES.json: legal access/repertoire and known prerequisites first; Action/components, actual native base and surcharge paid before interruption/results. No refund on counter or hidden failure. Actual pre-cast Dissonance determines surcharge; ordinary rank0/1–5/6–9 base0/1/2, consecutive same-family Refrain1/2/3; only the actual first prepared Wizard family gets0 base. Record all committed casts in chronological order. No hypothetical resources or class gates.
commonRules.clock: All examples use elapsed seconds and explicit regular phases repeating every6seconds. Expiry at a START occurs before budget/recharge refresh. No extra-turn clock reset. Full state records Action/Bonus Action/Reaction, movement cap/spent, concentration, components, inventory, roots, pending events and RNG cursor. Initial profiles are explicit NEW conditional scene participants with lawful class builds, not campaign roster assertions.
commonRules.harm: Use exact damage, Null, death and shared control interfaces. Each real damage packet is separate; no retrospective source-flag rewrite. A hard action denial requires the shared source-character/recipient/encounter gate. Existing immunities, stronger same-stat bonuses/penalties, paid source histories and lifecycle clocks survive. Known illegal attempts make no resource or cast-history mutation.
commonRules.scope: Authored tabletop/deterministic data only. No runtime execution, human play, numerical balance, cosmology, release, canonical-index application or closed-cohort reopening is represented. All NEW numerical values, classifications and physical fixtures are local proposed content, not recovered source facts.

questionRules.R8R-IDENTITY: PRESERVED: four independent identities and every original placement/class-access row in nativeSource. All actual grants here are rank8, minimum class level15, base21 RP, Action,120 feet,V/S/F. Prismatic Wall grants Abjuration to Cleric/Druid/Mage/Wizard; its four unassigned rank9 placements remain unassigned. Faction Convergence and Divine Intervention Lesser grant Divination to Cleric/Wizard. Reality Patch grants Universal to Cleric/Mage/Wizard, not Druid. No generic upcast or expanded class access. Exact original book/core disagreements remain in nativeSource; the supplied Core activation/range/components apply. New interpretations below are scoped only to the named spell. Source records remain unchanged and blocked until a separately authorized canonical application.
questionRules.R8R-AUTHORITY: PRESERVED: exact current735/113 authority supersedes Conference01's525/323. Accepted comparisons retain their own scope and digest; later backing-file edits are not accepted merely by resemblance. Original gods/planes assertions remain evidence, not deity statistics, automatic divine rescue, creature classification or current campaign epoch. Seven-member Choir and public theology remain distinct; no Fifteenfold-name-to-Choir mapping. Current accepted Null, death, casting, timing, control and body interfaces apply exactly. Retain GP-U01..17 and all inherited qualifications; GP-U15's historical pending label does not reopen now-applied EPI mechanics. Missing ancestor receipts/drafts are retained as provenance limitations, never executed or substituted for the exact operative records supplied.
questionRules.R8R-PRISM-LAYERS: NEW PW169 layers, in fixed near-to-far order L1..L7: L1 fire/DEX, L2 cold/CON, L3 lightning/DEX, L4 acid/DEX, L5 thunder/CON, L6 radiant/WIS, L7 psychic/WIS. Each independent contact deals16 of its type on a failed save against the wall caster's actual spell DC,8 on success, then applies its failed-save rider only if the recipient is eligible: L1 one4-fire ember packet at contact+6 elapsed seconds; L2 Speed−10 to minimum0 until contact+6; L3 cannot take Reactions until contact+6; L4 flat AC−2 until contact+6, strongest applicable same-stat penalty only; L5 Prone; L6 Blinded until contact+6; L7 Stunned until contact+6, only if this source-character/recipient/encounter has not already established its one hard action-denial effect. The shared hard gate is spent only on actual establishment; blocked immunity does not spend it. Damage still resolves if a rider is immune or hard-gated. Prone lasts until independently ended; the timed riders use fixed elapsed endpoints, not new turn markers. Identical riders do not add their numerical magnitude; independent source instances keep deadlines. No external rainbow death, petrification, plane transfer or item destruction table is imported.
questionRules.R8R-PRISM-GEOMETRY: NEW: one fixed vertical rectangular wall exactly30 feet wide,15 feet high,7 feet thick, seven adjacent1-foot slabs. Choose near-face normal and full placement before payment; the entire volume must be within120 feet under the accepted grid metric and have originating line of effect to the chosen near surface. The volume must be free of creature bodies, solid terrain and independent objects; boundary contact with ground is allowed. Known conflict rejects before payment; actual hidden conflict defeats the paid formation without an occupancy diagnostic, reshaping or refund. Self-supported light creates no material, horizontal platform or physical cover. Active layers are opaque to ordinary vision, but bodies, gear, projectiles, air, sound and spell line of effect can pass; lack of required perception still prevents a sight-dependent target. No extra illumination radius, structural support or arbitrary dome is granted.
questionRules.R8R-PRISM-CROSSING: NEW: record continuous whole-body sweeps, not center-only tiles. The first contact of each independent creature body with any active intact portion of a layer consumes that body/layer/cast contact permission before its save/defenses; each layer can affect each creature only once during this cast. Surface contact while moving inward counts; merely remaining beside the face does not. Resolve simultaneous contacts in L1..L7 order; ordinary travel from the far face naturally encounters L7 first. Finish each save, separate damage event, zero/lifecycle transition and rider before allowing more movement; recalculate remaining movement from actual spent cost and current Speed. Stopping or reversing is legal with the real budget and conditions; spent contacts do not replay on reentry, suppression, loading or reversal. Every passenger is a separate body; clothing does not convert it to an item. Actual forced-movement providers retain their own timing and never grant voluntary movement. Teleports have no intervening path: only actual destination-body overlap contacts layers, L1..L7 for simultaneous admission, after the transport's own legal atomic placement. Outside-to-outside endpoints do not touch the wall. Mandatory endings retain their own precedence. Neither endpoint travel nor carried-body positive examples are asserted without actual providers/custody. One cast damage root records the actual caster/dealer and Null Veil flag at wall creation. All layer and delayed ember packets inherit it. Each packet takes its own recipient HP/temp/Wounds/lifecycle snapshot, defenses, Wound/zero/Concentration processing; qualifying Null damage suppresses damage-caused Wounds and Instant Death even at positive HP. Living positive→0 becomes Stable0 with one recovery roll; already Stable/Dying zero states keep their own counters/deadlines. Independent riders, source ending and Hunt rules remain independent.
questionRules.R8R-PRISM-COUNTERS: NEW: an actually acquired operative dispel may select the whole perceived wall or one perceived exposed layer as its one ongoing-effect target. Both use the wall's actual generating rank8; choosing one layer does not reduce the rank or price. A successful layer termination permanently marks only that layer removed in this cast; whole-source termination ends every layer and pending ember sourced by this wall. A removed layer's already-applied independent timed rider retains its endpoint, but its unapplied ember is canceled. Wizard Arch Dispel is the actual rank3 class matrix,3RP,Action60feet,recharge2,INT+PB versus18 for this wall. Ordinary Dispel Magic's rank≤3 limit does not remove it. Greater Dispel requires its actual acquired source and cost, never an assumed grant or rank mapping. No thematic color counter is granted. Ordinary damage does not reduce this nonmaterial wall: it has no HP. Save/resistance/immunity avoids only the relevant damage/rider, not the source.
questionRules.R8R-PRISM-ENDING: NEW: concentration and the original60-elapsed-second deadline run continuously. Suppression records the actual clipped intersection of each1-foot slab and fixed2.5-by2.5-foot face panel (with edge remainders); no rectangular enlargement of a spherical field. On resumption an occupied previously suppressed piece stays wholly absent until that exact piece is clear. Never-suppressed pieces remain active. Returning light does not count as creature entry, push, cut or retroactive contact; after clearance, later actual creature entry can spend an unused contact. Removed layers never return. Deadline, concentration loss, death/incapacitation or eligible whole termination ends the wall and its not-yet-delivered ember packets, without erasing completed damage, contact history or already-applied independent riders. A new legal cast pays in full and ends incompatible old concentration at commitment, even if countered; only a successfully resolved new wall has a new root/contact ledger. It does not restore the old cast or reset shared hard-control guards.
